/docs/practice-problems/mean-squared-err.title: Practice: Mean Squared Error From Scratch
/docs/practice-problems/mean-squared-err.description: Implement mean squared error from scratch -- the loss Linear Regression minimizes -- with real edge-case handling for mismatched or empty inputs.

/docs/practice-problems/min-window-subst.title: Practice: Minimum Window Substring

/docs/practice-problems/numerical-gradie.title: Practice: Numerical Gradient via Finite Differences
